prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and increase strength through weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day
Total daily protein intake meets or exceeds 150g
Meals are practical, compact, and realistic for a single day
Macro ratios support strength/muscle building (high protein emphasis)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) requiring high protein intake (150g+) across 4-5 meals with specific macro ratios

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon preparation with carbohydrate loading and optimal hydration for a 42km race

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 60-65% of total energy intake
Includes 4-5 eating occasions with specific hydration strategy (water intake and electrolyte timing)
All meals and snacks are practical, single-day consumable items suitable for an endurance athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and hydration strategy

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize energy and recovery for a competitive soccer match with training session

solution_criteria: Includes pre-game meal (2-3 hours before match) with easily digestible carbs and moderate protein
Includes during-game quick energy source suitable for halftime or water breaks
Includes post-game recovery meal within 1-2 hours with protein and carbs for muscle repair
All meals are vegetarian and nut-free, totaling approximately 2,800-3,200 calories appropriate for the athlete's weight and activity level
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (soccer player) needing balanced nutrition with pre/during/post-game meal considerations and quick energy sources
